author: Ankit
problem: Read an integer X (between -10^18 and 10^18) and print X / 10 rounded up to an integer.
bug_description: When X is a multiple of 10 it prints X instead of X // 10.

comments.accurate: Prints the ceiling of X divided by 10, also for negative X
comments.wrong_behavior: Multiples of 10 are printed unchanged; other values are divided by 10 and rounded up
comments.wrong_location: Multiple-of-10 case verified; check the floor division rounding for negative X
